## Summary

- What did this PR create or update?
- Which issue does it resolve?
- Which audience does it serve?

## Evidence

- Which research notes or references were used?
- What facts or claims need extra caution?

## Risk Check

- [ ] No medical diagnosis-like language
- [ ] No fear-based or exaggerated claims
- [ ] Sensitive language reviewed
- [ ] Clear boundary between general information and professional advice

## Output Checklist

- [ ] Blog draft added or updated
- [ ] Channel-specific copy prepared
- [ ] Safety review requested
- [ ] Distribution handoff included

## Reviewer Focus

- Safety agent: check risk and phrasing
- Brand reviewer: check tone and trust
- Chief agent: decide publish / revise / hold
